From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Strategic runway & QBR: account scrub and consolidated forecast

Team —

We need a tight, account-by-account scrub for the QBR deck next week. Goal: a one-page snapshot per named account + a consolidated forecast that rolls up into the exec slide. Please prioritize Novus Labs, Orion Health, and Vectra Analytics.

Asks:
- Owners: confirm ACV, committed close date, and current confidence (High/Med/Low) for each active opportunity.
- Risk tags: list 1–2 blockers per deal (procurement, legal, POC, budget).
- One-line impact statement we can use in the exec slide (focus on timing + blocker).

Deliverables and deadlines:
- Account one-pagers (shared Drive folder): 2026-11-13 12:00 PT
- Consolidated forecast (template attached): 2026-11-13 15:00 PT
- Exec-ready 3-slide summary: 2026-11-14 09:00 PT

I've attached the first-pass rollup (QBR_account_rollup_v1.xlsx). Markus — can you reconcile the historical closes vs. forecast figures and merge into the QBR_account_rollup_v2.pdf?

Thanks — short sync if helpful.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QBR_account_rollup_v1.xlsx (Excel, 320KB)]

I ran the rollup against CRM commits and adjusted the Novus Lines (see notes column). Major changes:
- Novus: moved $420k from 'commit' -> 'best case' after procurement flagged a contract escalation.

Attached: QBR_account_rollup_v2.pdf (PDF export) and a short reconciliation tab in the spreadsheet.

Action items I will own:
- Merge final numbers into the consolidated forecast (due 11/13 15:00)
- Add a confidence column + short rationale for each deal

Subject: Re: Strategic runway & QBR: account scrub and consolidated forecast

Good work getting this moving. A few leadership priorities to bake in:
1) Flag any deal > $250k with a single-point-of-failure (procurement/legal blocking) as "exec attention" — we'll include a one-line ask per deal for what we need from leadership.
2) For the exec slide, we want 2 items: runway ($ by month) and 3 biggest risks with mitigations. Keep the one-line impact statement punchy (target + blocker).
3) Novus is part of our top-10 focus list; if confidence is Medium or Low, include a quick contingency (e.g., alternate contact, pilot acceleration).

Markus — please surface a 1-line recommended leadership ask for Novus (credit, contract exception, or legal prioritization).

I can join a 15-min sync this afternoon if the team wants to run the final rollup before EOD.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, GTM | Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Markus —

Thanks for the heads up and the template. Quick update from our side: procurement has requested a new SSO clause and a revised data retention appendix; that has paused legal sign-off. That means the $420k line Markus mentioned will likely slip to next quarter unless the contract exceptions can be prioritized.

Attaching our updated MAP (Mutual Action Plan) and the latest procurement note. We can move legal review up if Redwood can send the proposed SSO language and confirm the data retention options by EOD Monday (11/16).

Attachments: Novus_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, Novus_Procurement_Note.pdf

Jane Park

jane.park@novus-labs.com

Date: 2026-11-13T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Strategic runway & QBR: account scrub and consolidated forecast — final asks

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Final consolidation and next steps below (please treat as checklist).

1) Account one-pagers: ensure the Drive folder has one-pagers for Novus, Orion, Vectra by 11/14 10:00 PT. Include: owner, ACV, commit date, confidence, 1–2 risk tags, one-line impact. Owner: sales AE.
2) Consolidated forecast: Markus will drop the consolidated numbers into the QBR_account_rollup_v2.pdf and confirm the rollup by 11/13 18:00 PT (done).
3) Leadership asks: for Novus — recommended ask: "Legal prioritization for SSO clause + data retention appendix (exec note)" (Aditya approved). Markus to add a 1-line ask in the notes column.
4) External follow-up: Jane asked for proposed SSO language by EOD 11/16 — Legal/Platform to own (cc'd in separate thread).
5) Exec slides: Tessa please assemble the 3-slide summary once the one-pagers are in Drive; aim for 11/14 09:00 PT.

Owners and quick contacts:
- Novus Labs: AE = Marcus Li (cc in CRM), Owner for one-pager: Marcus Li
- Orion Health: AE = Tessa Morgan, Owner for one-pager: Tessa Morgan
- Vectra Analytics: AE = Rishi Malhotra, Owner for one-pager: Rishi Malhotra

I'll publish the consolidated rollup to the Drive and HubSpot (HS-12345) after Markus confirms the final numbers. If any owner anticipates missing the 11/13 windows, call me directly — we will re-prioritize.

Thanks — tight scope, clear asks.

Evelyn Hart
Head of GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
